notes.title: Thanks and farewell!
notes.content:
After all the great support and fast paced food fighting action, we are retiring Alien Food Frenzy for sale.  All the best to the community!

Farewell!

notes.title: Updated With Alien Pop Gun Among Other Improvements
notes.content: Alien Food Frenzy has been updated to increase the fun!  Mom now finds an alien pop gun so you can blast the alien foods and send them flying.  Watch out, a new alien food defense mechanism has been added to even the score.  We've also improved some of the collisions - you can hit grapes tossed at you with the bat and those projectiles do damage.  Technical improvements include updated Unity version and Steam VR 2.0.  One more thing, the weapons now snap on with the trigger so you don't have to hold the trigger down to keep bats, hammers, lids in hand.  Trigger to grab, trigger to drop.  For the pop gun, trigger to grab, trigger to shoot, grab grip to drop.

notes.title: Vive Tracker Support Added
notes.content: Alien Food Frenzy now supports Vive Trackers! Use two Vive Trackers as your feet in the game. Punch, toss and now truly kick your way to victory! Check out the video on the store page to see how it's done. Note: the game still works without Vive Trackers, you use the Vive Controllers to kick and stomp instead. Email us at admin@alienfoodfrenzy.com with any questions about the game or to report a bug. Happy gaming!

notes.title: Made easy mode... well easier
notes.content:
Given user feedback we've made easy mode easier.  In early rounds there are fewer foods in the rooms at the same time and the onslaught of foods has longer waits before new foods enter.  Also, damage inflicted by the little food enemies is reduced so you last longer.

Retroactive Post - Release date February 22, 2018
